'''Brisha Shard''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Deltron (species)|Deltron]] who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the early stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[MedStar-class frigate/Legends|''MedStar''-class frigate]] ''[[Golandras]]''. She had one son, [[Alarik]], and two daughters, [[Bellen]] and [[Viqi]]. While she viewed the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] as meat-droids, she also acknowledged that their creation kept her children from being drafted in the war. At some point between the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] and the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skye/Legends|Marat V]] was taken over by the terrorist [[Zeta Magnus]]. Captain Shard was dispatched to the edge of the [[Marat system/Legends|Marat system]], officially on a relief mission to deliver [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and aid to Marat V. In truth, the captain was tasked with bringing three [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Halagad Ventor]], and a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Tark Squad|unit]] to Marat V so they could dethrone Magnus. However, the ''Golandras'' fell victim to an orbital ambush in the form of an [[Cloaked mine|invisible minefield]]. Although Shard could not save her ship, she still managed to shoot off the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] that contained the Jedi and the clone commandos before it was too late. Fatally crippled, Shard [[Death/Legends|died]] on the bridge of the ''Golandras'', and the vessel exploded shortly thereafter.<ref name="Skyewalkers" />
